title: etcd API — Lease semantics (v3.7)
version: etcd v3.7 official online documentation; accessed 2026-11-26.
locator: Lease API: a key may be attached to one lease; when a lease expires or is revoked, all attached keys are deleted. Lease TTL and keep-alive are server-managed.
notes: Supports the proposed shared-TTL lifetime of global permit slot, tenant permit slot and Admission lease record. Production expiration/reconciliation behavior has not been tested against a live etcd cluster.
